Welcome to the Shopping Paradise

One of the largest shopping & entertainment centres in Iraq.

’09.

Majidi Mall opened its doors on 23 November 2009 — with an architectural design that pushes new boundaries in what a shopping centre can be.

Visitors shop in an air-conditioned, hygienic and safe environment that combines natural daylight with the spaciousness of open-air streets.

As Iraq’s most entertaining shopping centre, it is home to a 6D cinema, delicious food and limitless entertainment in Game Land — all in one place, presenting a new way of living.
